blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.description: Powers up Fire moves when HP is low.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.description: Powers up Water moves when HP is low.

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.description: Powers up Grass moves when HP is low.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.description: Powers up Bug moves when HP is low.

guts.name: Guts
guts.description: Boosts Attack when affected by a status condition.

thick_fat.name: Thick Fat
thick_fat.description: Reduces Fire and Ice damage taken by half.

flash_fire.name: Flash Fire
flash_fire.description: Absorbs Fire moves to power up own Fire attacks.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.description: Survives any hit with 1 HP if at full health.

multiscale.name: Multiscale
multiscale.description: Halves damage taken when at full HP.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.description: Lowers the foe's Attack when entering battle.

poison_heal.name: Poison Heal
poison_heal.description: Heals HP instead of taking poison damage.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.description: The foe uses more PP for moves.

shed_skin.name: Shed Skin
shed_skin.description: May heal status conditions over time.

run_away.name: Run Away
run_away.description: Can always flee from wild Pokemon.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.description: Passes status conditions to the foe.
